upasagga.p: [Upa+saja(=sajja)+ṇa.(1)upeccattha] (pu) Google Translate [Sajjantīti upasaggā hi pādayo.] (1) The word - Upasagga. (2) Suffering. Clinging. The manner of attachment (on). Danger or harm. Destruction. Affliction. (2) Red rot colletotrichuna falcaturns (disease) of sugarcane. Upasagga(pu) [upasagga+a] Like Red rot colletotrichuna falcaturns (disease) of sugarcane.
